brief: GS's 9 Nov 2026 US equities desk note describes an 'Everything Rally' (SPX +2.3% to 7,549, NDX +3.4%, SOX +6.8% despite NVDA -4.3%, RTY +3.3%, 420+ S&P names up) as the market digests a wild post-election week of violent rotations, pressure on investor performance, and big hedge-fund gross/net and tech-length cuts. Oil fell roughly 5% to $85 on further Iran de-escalation after Trump called extensive strikes 'highly unlikely,' conditional on Iran signing a strong agreement, which also helped sentiment. Hedge funds finished net buyers via macro products and covered/bought tech (ex-NVDA), even as GS Prime Brokerage showed tech net allocation at 14.4%, multi-year-low percentiles, with semis positioning almost fully roundtripped in 2026. GIR called semis 'clearly oversold,' favoring AVGO/NVDA (AI compute), AMAT/LRCX (semicap) and SK Hynix/Samsung (memory, trading below tangible book), arguing current valuations price in no growth or capex past 2027. The desk stayed cautious ahead of Tuesday's CPI (GIR forecasts +16bps core) and CRWV/NBIS earnings. In derivatives, VVIX posted its 3rd-sharpest 20-year daily drop, SPY downside unwound into upside buying, and the desk likes IWM upside into month-end on seasonality, CTA buying, low positioning and a high short base.
